account.title: Account Settings
account.subtitle: Manage your account details and preferences.

onboarding.feature_1_desc: Track meals, symptoms, and reintroduction challenges. The app's Home screen and log form adapt to your current phase.
onboarding.feature_2_desc: Instantly check if a food is safe, analyze ingredient lists from a photo, and get personalized advice based on your profile.
onboarding.feature_3_desc: As you log your triggers and safe foods, the app "auto-scans" your history to build your final, long-term personalized diet.
onboarding.profile_desc: This info helps the AI Assistant give you safer, more accurate advice. It's saved only in your browser.
onboarding.phase_title: Where are you in your journey?
onboarding.phase_desc: Select your current phase to set up your Home screen. You can change this any time from the side menu.
